topic: 1-Minute Salon Reel: The 3-Second Trick That Doubles Booking Clicks
title: 1-Minute Salon Reel: The 3-Second Trick
title_options: Quick Reel Hack for More Salon Bookings
description:
Use the first three seconds of any salon reel to show one clear service and the exact booking button text. This simple swap costs nothing and takes under a minute to set up.

I give a copyable example for a nail salon, plus the exact on-screen text and caption to use. Try it tomorrow and keep the first three seconds consistent across reels.

scenes.narration: Double booking clicks in three seconds?
scenes.doodle_prompt: stylist next to an empty salon chair, wall clock

scenes.narration: Start your reel with a three-second clear offer. Show the exact service name and booking button text.
Example for a nail salon: film hands painting gel nails for three seconds. Put on-screen: Book GEL MANICURE.
scenes.doodle_prompt: two hands, nail polish brush painting a nail

scenes.narration: Then make your booking link point straight to that exact service page. Set the booking button text to match the words shown.
Caption to copy: 'Book GEL MANICURE — $45.' Use those same three words as the booking button. Keep it consistent across reels.
scenes.doodle_prompt: nail salon counter with a small tip jar and a single appointment card

scenes.narration: Film three seconds that match the button text. Test one reel this week and watch clicks. Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
